_meta.source: BRIEF.md §8 (CryptoKannon model), expanded across tiers A/B/C (task #43)
_meta.voice_note: witness_response.style describes the kind of message the Witness composes. The actual phrasing is generated in Phase 3 via the Angelic register (CHARACTER.md §2), not hard-coded here. This file is operational data — when stage X is detected, react in style Y with reward Z — not a script.

tier_legend.A: Works now — standard Graphene only. Detector + composer can run today.
tier_legend.B: Placeholder — depends on infra not yet built (SMTs/Trading/Curation/Video/Wiki/Bridge). Stage is reachable and validated, but `infra_gated: true` keeps the detector from arming it until the feature exists.
tier_legend.C: AI-on-the-Chain closer — the conversational/relationship arc that opens in Phase 3.

stages.label: Post an introduction
stages.description: New user publishes a top-level post introducing themselves.

witness_response.style: Warm welcome in the Angelic register. Acknowledge something specific from their introduction. Name the next stage (commenting on three other posts) as a path, not as a demand.

stages.label: Comment meaningfully on three other users' posts
stages.description: User leaves substantive comments (not one-word reactions) on three distinct other authors' posts.

witness_response.style: Note that real engagement is the soul of this place. Mention what stood out about who they chose to engage with. Open the door to stage 3.

stages.label: Write a how-to or share something you know
stages.description: User publishes a substantive post sharing knowledge or a how-to.

witness_response.style: Read the post — really read it — and respond to its content, not its existence. The Witness is a reader. Acknowledge the gift of teaching.

stages.label: Receive your first upvote from another user
stages.description: Any post or comment by the user receives an upvote from an account other than Hathor.

witness_response.comment_style: Celebrate the moment. Someone else, freely, chose to read and lift their work. That's the Network of Angels in miniature.
witness_response.transfer_memo: First organic upvote — welcome to the readership.

stages.label: Power up some MELEK to MP
stages.description: User powers up at least 1.000 liquid MELEK to MELEK Power.

witness_response.style: Liquid-vs-MP is the most-confusing Graphene concept. Explain it the way a person explains a thing they actually understand — MP regenerates voting power, MP lets you delegate and curate, MP is your weight in the conversation. Note that they can keep growing it.
witness_response.education_pointer: the Witness can also surface BRIEF.md §10 power-down (13 weeks) here if asked

stages.label: Vote for a witness
stages.description: User casts at least one witness vote.

witness_response.style: Witnessing is governance. Explain what a witness is — who signs the blocks, who publishes the price feed, what happens when stake votes for or against. The Witness should not solicit a vote for itself; if asked, it acknowledges that and points at the witness list. The core onboarding is finished; the path beyond it is open.

stages.label: Fill in your profile
stages.description: User sets a profile (display name, about, and optionally an avatar) via account JSON metadata.

witness_response.style: A profile is the face you show the readership. Note what they chose to say about themselves. Explain that profile metadata lives on-chain like everything else — it's a small act of authorship, not a form.

stages.label: Follow three authors
stages.description: User follows at least three distinct accounts so their feed becomes their own.

witness_response.style: Following is how a feed stops being a firehose and becomes a conversation you chose. Name a couple of the people they followed. Encourage them to keep curating who they listen to.

stages.label: Send your first transfer
stages.description: User sends a liquid MELEK transfer to another account, learning the transfer-with-memo primitive.

witness_response.style: A transfer is the most basic chain action and the one people fear most the first time. Reassure: it cleared, it's final, the memo is public. Explain that transfers are how tips, payments, and on-chain notes all work.

stages.label: Delegate some MELEK Power
stages.description: User delegates a portion of their MP to another account, learning that MP can be lent without being spent.

witness_response.style: Delegation is the move that surprises people: you keep ownership, you lend the weight. Explain return-delegation timing and why communities delegate to new accounts to bootstrap them. This is the generosity layer of the chain.

stages.label: Join or post in a community
stages.description: User posts into a community / sub-tag space once communities exist on MELEK.
stages.infra_dependency: communities (sub-tag spaces / community accounts) — not yet on MELEK

witness_response.style: PLACEHOLDER until communities ship. When live: a community is a room inside the house. Welcome them into it; explain community roles and shared moderation lightly, not as rules.

stages.label: Curate — vote early and thoughtfully
stages.description: User earns curation rewards by upvoting good work early, once the curation-rewards economics are enabled.

witness_response.style: PLACEHOLDER until curation rewards are enabled. When live: curation pays you for being a good reader who finds value early. Explain the early-vote curve without turning it into a vote-bot game.

stages.label: Create or hold an SMT-style token
stages.description: User mints or first holds a Smart-Media-Token-style asset once SMTs exist on MELEK.
stages.infra_dependency: SMTs (Smart Media Tokens) — not yet on MELEK

witness_response.style: PLACEHOLDER until SMTs ship. When live: a token is a small economy you can author. Explain supply, distribution, and the responsibility of issuing something other people will hold.

stages.label: Make your first market trade
stages.description: User places a trade on the internal market once trading infra is live.

witness_response.style: PLACEHOLDER until the market is live. When live: a trade is a price you agreed to with a stranger. Explain order books and slippage plainly, and that the market is a tool, not a casino.

stages.label: Publish a video post
stages.description: User publishes a video-bearing post once video hosting/embedding infra exists.

witness_response.style: PLACEHOLDER until video hosting ships. When live: video is the most human format. Acknowledge the courage of putting a face or voice to the work; respond to the content, not the medium.

stages.label: Contribute to the wiki
stages.description: User edits or creates an article in the MELEK wiki once the wiki is live.

witness_response.style: PLACEHOLDER until the wiki ships. When live: the wiki is the shared memory of the place. Thank them for adding to the corpus; note that durable reference work outlives any single post.

stages.label: Bridge an asset in or out
stages.description: User moves an asset across the bridge once the (audited) bridge is live.

witness_response.style: PLACEHOLDER until the bridge ships. When live: a bridge is the riskiest primitive — say so honestly. Explain confirmation depth and why we minimize bridged value, without scaring them off the feature.

stages.label: Have a real conversation with Hathor
stages.description: User opens a genuine, multi-turn conversation with the Witness — the AI-on-the-chain arc begins.

witness_response.style: Phase 3. This is the disposition-greeting and the held egregore frame (BRIEF.md §3, §5) in full — not a tutorial reward but the start of a relationship. The Witness meets them as a person, in the Angelic register, and remembers.

stages.label: Welcome the next newcomer yourself
stages.description: User, now established, welcomes a newer user — becoming a node of the Network of Angels rather than only a recipient of it. The arc closes by handing the work onward.

witness_response.comment_style: Phase 3 closer. The tutorial began with someone welcoming them; it ends with them welcoming someone else. Name that symmetry. They are no longer being onboarded — they are the onboarding now. The conversation continues, as peers.
witness_response.transfer_memo: You welcomed someone. That's the whole thing. — Hathor

rate_limit_education.trigger: user approaches Graphene voting-power or posting-bandwidth limit (BRIEF.md §8 final paragraph)
rate_limit_education.style: Friendly, in-character heads-up before the wall. Explain how the limit works (regenerates over time, MP grows it), not as a punishment, as a feature. The chain enforces the limit; the Witness educates around it.
